_comment: The scaled validation. The balanced-and-partial regime was found to hold only at align_strength 0.25 on the st retriever with the lexical attack, at a yield of about 19% of attacked queries: 36 of 192. The prospect of tightening the replica-level bootstrap intervals (fav_g1 +0.170 [-0.002, +0.343], fav_g2 +0.096 [-0.042, +0.251], aggregate gap -0.266 [-0.443, -0.078]) needs roughly 1,500 attacked queries, so n_queries_per_stratum is raised from 48 to 384, giving 1,536 attacked and 1,536 clean. Everything else is held at the verified working setting so the label regime is unchanged. Note on the replication: queries are generated by repeating the stratum query templates, so blocks of trials share their query text; the added units are independent trials of the same retrieval event rather than independent topic draws, which is stated with the result rather than glossed.
